name: contact_reason
description: Why the customer got in touch and whether it was sorted

signals.name: reason
signals.instructions: What is the main reason the customer contacted support?

criteria.return_or_refund: Customer wants to return an item, exchange it, or get money back
criteria.delivery_issue: Order is late, missing, delivered to the wrong place or marked delivered but not received
criteria.product_question: Customer asks about a product's size, material, stock or how to use it, before or after buying
criteria.order_change: Customer wants to cancel, change the address, or change items on an order not yet delivered
criteria.payment_issue: Double charge, failed payment, coupon not applied, or a refund not received

signals.name: resolved
signals.instructions: By the end of the conversation, was the customer's issue resolved or a clear fix agreed?

criteria.true: The agent fixed it or both agreed on a concrete next step with a date (pickup booked, refund initiated, replacement shipped)
criteria.false: The issue is still open, the customer was told to wait with no date, or the customer left unhappy

name: return_details
description: Why the item is coming back, asked only for returns and refunds

signals.name: return_reason
signals.instructions: Why is the customer returning the item? Only use a reason the customer actually gave.

criteria.wrong_size: Item does not fit: too small, too big, size chart was off
criteria.damaged: Item arrived broken, torn, stained or defective
criteria.not_as_described: Colour, material or quality is different from the photos or description
criteria.changed_mind: Customer no longer wants it, found it cheaper, or ordered by mistake
criteria.late_delivery: Item came too late to be useful
criteria.other: Another reason, or the customer gave none

name: customer_risk
description: Signs the customer may stop buying from us

signals.name: churn_risk
signals.instructions: How likely is this customer to stop shopping with us, judging by what they said?
criteria: Low: happy or neutral, no sign of leaving
Some: disappointed, but still willing to order again
High: says they are fed up, compares us to other stores, or doubts they will order again
Leaving: says they will stop ordering, uninstall the app or close their account

signals.name: competitor_mentioned
signals.instructions: Did the customer mention another store, app or brand they could buy from instead?

criteria.true: Customer names or refers to another shopping app, store or brand as an alternative
criteria.false: No other store or brand is mentioned
